functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase1_review()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM phase1_submissions s JOIN phase1_applications a ON a.id=s.application_id
    JOIN students st ON st.id=a.student_id JOIN selection_cohorts c ON c.id=NEW.cohort_id
    JOIN users u ON u.id=NEW.reviewed_by
    WHERE s.id=NEW.submission_id AND a.id=NEW.application_id AND c.cycle_id=a.cycle_id
      AND c.department=st.department AND c.program=st.program AND c.status='ACTIVE'
      AND c.coordinator_id=NEW.reviewed_by AND u.role='COORDINATOR' AND u.account_status='ACTIVE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Review scope or snapshot mismatch' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: guard_selection_panel
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_selection_panel()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id=NEW.coordinator_id AND role='COORDINATOR' AND account_status='ACTIVE')
    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE id IN (NEW.committee_one,NEW.committee_two,NEW.committee_three)
      AND role='COMMITTEE' AND account_status='ACTIVE')<>3 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Panel requires an active Coordinator and three distinct active Committee users' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.prevent_linked_student_role_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.role <> 'STUDENT' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM students
        WHERE user_id = NEW.id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'a user linked to a Student must retain role STUDENT'
            USING ERRCODE = '23514',
                  CONSTRAINT = 'chk_students_user_role';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: reject_immutable_row_mutation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_immutable_row_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION '% is append-only; % is not allowed', TG_TABLE_NAME, TG_OP
        USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END;
$function$
